PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?zname ?tsid ?point_uri ?point_class WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:Air_Handling_Unit ; rdfs:label "AHU03" .
  ?zone brick:isFedBy ?ahu .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zname .
  ?point brick:hasPropertyOf ?zone ; a brick:Air_Temperature .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?tref .
  ?tref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?point_uri .
  ?point a ?point_class .
}
